title: T6020 (M2 Pro, G14S B1): honeykrisp-omarchy coopmat fork measured against stock Mesa via an extracted ICD; first G14 cooperative-matrix measurement in this repository's receipts

host.submitter: wickthumb (community; dataset rows 5c803596fd75 Linux deep, ea8c35bd20bf macOS deep, same laptop)

fork.package: mesa-honeykrisp-omarchy 26.3.0.devel.hk6f6afc8-1 built from packaging/mesa-honeykrisp-omarchy/PKGBUILD with makepkg -f (1m55s wall, 10 cores)
fork.how_loaded: package extracted (bsdtar) and the loader pointed at it: VK_DRIVER_FILES=<extract>/fork-icd.json (asahi_icd json with absolute library_path) and LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<extract>/usr/lib. System Mesa untouched; Hyprland kept running on stock GL. No sudo.

change.build_fix: packaging/mesa-honeykrisp-omarchy/Mesa-MLAA-License-Clarification-Email.txt added: the PKGBUILD's source=() names it (sha512 ecdabad21a86f04d…, the asahi-alarm mesa recipe file, AsahiLinux/PKGBUILDs mesa@28229b8) but the directory shipped only the PKGBUILD, so `makepkg` failed at 'was not found in the build directory' before this file existed
change.axes: docs/chip-capability-axes.json gains a measured t6020 row (both driver builds)

protocol: scripts/bench_matrix.py --mode run, engine scripts/bench_decode.py, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-4bit rev a5339a4131f135d0fdc6a5c8b5bbed2753bbe0f3, greedy temp 0 seed 0 warmup 4, EOS suppressed, MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE=1, clean_check clean (ollama.service stopped) for both passes

long-decode-128 (262/128).note: not a native-pinned leg; digest moved with the driver build as parity-id-policy allows. Stock value equals the jw14m2 T6021 receipt.

benchmark.fork_numeric_check: f32 matmul vs float64 host reference, normal(0,1) operands: max_abs_err 4.4e-05 / 1.0e-04 / 2.0e-04 at n=256/512/1024 (|ref| ~13/18/26); bf16 n=1024 max_abs_err 0.487 mean 0.036 (bf16 output rounding)

limitations: Not a §4 qualification: no arithmetic-contract probe set, no upstream suite battery, no bf16 digest legs, no native-Metal divisor for this die (macOS bench_decode run pending on the same laptop). install.sh's verified-SoC list is deliberately NOT changed by this receipt.
Fork loaded through a private ICD, not installed; GL/EGL side of the fork unexercised here.
One machine, one pass per leg per driver (his single-locked-pass protocol); clean_check clean both passes, ollama stopped.
The fork does not advertise VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float on G14 either; Scatter stays on FCAS.
Coopmat 8x8x8 fp32 shape enumeration not dumped by vulkaninfo text/JSON; evidence that the gate opened is the route-dependent throughput and the unchanged native digests.
